name: syo
description: Assets used by the SYO template. URIs are root-relative because the template is not inheritable, so Joomla would look for a bare filename under templates/syo/ rather than media/templates/site/syo/ and silently find nothing. Each asset has its own cache-busting version: bump it whenever that file changes.

assets.name: template.syo
assets.description: The main template stylesheet. Its dependencies load first so that it can override them.

assets.name: template.syo.fontawesome
assets.description: The template's own copy of Font Awesome. Not named "fontawesome": that would replace Joomla's core asset of the same name for every extension on the site.
